title: A Practical Guide to NERC CIP Compliance Using Picus
content_md: What Is NERC and What Does It Stand For? NERC stands for the North American Electric Reliability Corporation . It is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority focused on the reliability and security of the North American bulk power system. In the United States, NERC operates as the Electric Reliability Organization under Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) oversight.
